notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (tier 1 only, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed). Navigation discovery: parsed the homepage's Next.js RSC-embedded Storyblok CMS landing-page registry (182 distinct SEO/collection landing-page definitions with key/query/name/url fields, extracted directly from the site's own routing bundle) and cross-verified every bestseller-shaped candidate against sitemap.xml (1819 URLs). This is the same Algolia-backed (index 'web_product') architecture documented in notes/185.md for the prior Home-Decor pass; counts read from each page's server-rendered Algolia response, each explicitly flagged exhaustiveNbHits:true, and cross-checked via nbPages==ceil(nbHits/hitsPerPage) with hitsPerPage=24 in every case (all matched exactly). Genuine site-defined sub-structure: sitewide /bestsellers (tags[0]=bestsellers, qty 4) has 7 per-category children (Sofas/Tables/Chairs/Beds/Storage/Furniture Sets/Outdoor), all present in sitemap.xml; only 3 have non-zero counts (Sofa/Table/Bed Bestsellers, summing to exactly 4, matching the parent -- confirmed via each child page's own category facet breakdown, e.g. sofas/bestsellers facets show sofas:2 matching its nbHits:2). Chairs/Storage/Furniture Sets/Outdoor Bestsellers all returned nbHits:0 and were dropped per the zero-product rule. Excluded as NOT valid Bestsellers PLPs: /bestseller-sale ('Bestselling Furniture Sale', tags[0]=bestseller_sale), /sale/bestsellers-sale ('Bestsellers Furniture Sale', tags[0]=sale), and /best-of-castlery ('The Best Of Castlery', tags bestsellers+trending) -- all three are named/tagged as Sale or curated-editorial campaigns (not a Bestsellers listing itself), and all three now 307-redirect live to the generic /sg/sale page and are absent from sitemap.xml, confirming they are retired/dead routes, not active PLPs. No local-language variant needed (Singapore storefront is English-only).
